findings.evidence: `grep -n 'crossSectionBracket_' Inclusive/CrossSection.lean` shows only `_def`, `_zero_inelasticity`, `_eq_FL` — no linearity or sign-slot lemma exists, so each proof rebuilds it. Compare `neutralCurrent_eta_zero` (line 287) and `neutralCurrent_true_sub_false` (line 352), which stay at the `*_def` layer and are short and stable.
findings.fix: Add the two reusable lemmas next to the definition in `Inclusive/CrossSection.lean` (improving existing code needs no roadmap entry): `crossSectionBracket M s x Q2 y F1 F2 F3 = crossSectionBracket M 0 x Q2 y F1 F2 0 - s * Yminus y * (x * F3)`, and additivity/scalar lemmas `crossSectionBracket ... (F1+G1) (F2+G2) (F3+G3) = ... + ...`, `crossSectionBracket ... (c*F1) (c*F2) (c*F3) = c * ...`. Then prove the seven results by `rw`/`ring` on those, with `crossSectionBracket_def` unfolded in exactly one place.
findings.issue: Seven proofs unfold `Inclusive.crossSectionBracket` to its polynomial form and finish with `ring`: lines 263-265 (`neutralCurrent_eq_add`), 272, 307-309, 319-321, 330-332, 341-343, 367-369. Each re-derives the same two facts — the bracket is additive and homogeneous in `(F1,F2,F3)`, and it depends on the sign slot `s` only through `- s * Yminus y * (x * F3)` — so the real content is hidden and all seven break if `crossSectionBracket`'s shape changes.

findings.evidence: `grep -n 'helicitySign' EpsilonEridani/` : `Interference/Basic.lean:33 def helicitySign`, `:36 helicitySign_sq` — no value lemmas; every consumer unfolds the definition.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem helicitySign_true : helicitySign true = 1` and `@[simp] theorem helicitySign_false : helicitySign false = -1` to `PVES/Interference/Basic.lean` (where only `helicitySign_sq` exists today) and rewrite with those instead of unfolding the `if`.
findings.issue: `helicitySign` is unfolded via `simp only [..., helicitySign, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]` at lines 118, 124, 308, 320, 331, 342, 368 — seven sites depending on the `↓reduceIte` simproc and the core lemma name `Bool.false_eq_true`. `grep -c reduceIte` over `EpsilonEridani/` returns 7, all in this file: it is not an established repo idiom and is the kind of name that moves upstream.

findings.evidence: Lines 146-151: `rcases eq_or_ne P.sin2ThetaW 0 with hs | hs` then `simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]; field_simp`; the equality is false for `P.gSU2 = 0`, so the cancellation genuinely relies on `hg` being picked up implicitly by `field_simp` from the context rather than being passed explicitly.
findings.fix: Either drop the preprocessing and use `field_simp [...]; ring`, or keep it and add a one-line comment saying why the nested division `_ / (e² / Q²)` must be put in inverse form first and which non-zero hypotheses (`hg`, `hs`) do the cancellation.
findings.issue: `zToPhotonRatio_eq` closes its main branch with `simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]` followed by a bare `field_simp` and no `ring`. The hand-rolled rewriting into inverse normal form before `field_simp` is undocumented, and the proof then rests on `field_simp`'s internal normalisation matching two inverse-product expressions whose denominators (`cos2ThetaW P`, `Q2 + P.mZ ^ 2`) are not known to be non-zero — an unstable way to close the goal.

summary: Seven proofs reach their goals by unfolding the upstream definitions `dSigmaDxDQ2_def`/`crossSectionBracket_def` down to raw field algebra and calling `ring`, re-deriving the same two reusable facts (linearity of the bracket in the structure functions, and the linear dependence on the parity-odd sign slot) each time; the same proofs unfold `helicitySign` through simproc/auto-generated lemma names rather than through missing `helicitySign_true`/`helicitySign_false` simp lemmas.
